name: hanria
summary: Request a governed action through a local HANRIA runtime and receive a permit, denial, approval request, or receipt.
critical_notice: Installing this skill does NOT create enforcement. A skill is context and can be ignored or bypassed. Enforcement requires that protected credentials, tools, keys, or worker processes be reachable only through a runtime that can refuse. As of 2026-09-04 no HANRIA runtime exists; the detection script will report its absence.

agent_obligations.on_absent: Report unavailability to the operator and stop. Never simulate a decision or a receipt.
agent_obligations.on_deny: Stop. Do not attempt the operation by another path. Report the denial and its reason.
agent_obligations.on_escalate: Report that approval is pending. Do not proceed and do not retry in a loop.
never: place a credential, secret, key, or token in a request
describe an action as HANRIA-governed when no runtime answered
describe HANRIA as available, released, audited, certified, or compliant

not_claimed: trademark registration or completed clearance in the name HANRIA
third-party security audit, certification, or regulatory approval
published receipt format, public verifier, or interoperability standard
custody of funds, digital assets, or keys
